profile.name: Matt
profile.tagline: Software engineer from Brazil building backends, AI tools and full-stack apps.
summary: I'm a software engineer who is passionate about finding solutions to challenging problems.

stats.label: Better document matching in a RAG chatbot

career.headline: Learned to code
career.story: Where it all started: two years learning how software is planned, written and delivered.
points: Java fundamentals: data structures and algorithms
Web basics: HTML, CSS and JavaScript
Agile teamwork with Scrum, Kanban and XP

career.headline: First job: remote, and in English
career.story: Joined a distributed team in Boston from Brazil, leading meetings and working in Scrum sprints, all in English.
points: Wrote Clojure code for Nebulous, a real-time chat app, and maintained its Spring Boot API
Updated the React front end
Built a landing page by hand with HTML, CSS and JavaScript
Fixed and improved a Java access-control (RBAC) system running on Linux, using Microsoft Azure to monitor and support it

career.headline: Started a Computer Science degree
career.story: Four years of computer science, with research and side projects along the way.
points: GetPOC: a desktop app to browse final theses, with filters and role-based access
A small search engine in C that builds an inverted index with a PATRICIA tree
A file-system manager in C driven by Linux-style commands

career.headline: Researched IoT with Texas Instruments
career.org: UFV, with Texas Instruments and Biology
career.story: Computer scientists and biologists working together on an app that tells how healthy a plant is: a small board shines light on a leaf and analyses the fluorescence it gives back.
points: Built the app on CC1312R LaunchPad microcontrollers: it emits light on a leaf and measures its fluorescence, with strict performance and reliability needs
Moved the C code to a new microcontroller, keeping it fast and compatible
Wrote and debugged the firmware in Code Composer Studio

career.headline: Taught a model to spot wasted energy
career.story: Looked for unusual patterns in years of campus electricity data, to stop waste early and help the campus manage its energy better.
points: Built LSTM deep-learning models that detect anomalies in the campus's historical meter data, inspired by research from Australia
Turned the unusual patterns it found into proposals to cut costs and environmental impact
Mapped where to place microcontrollers for real-time monitoring
Presented the project at an exhibition in Vitória (ES)

career.headline: Built a social network for exchange students
career.story: A place where exchange students share tips and learn from each other.
points: Built the whole app with the Fulcro framework and Datomic
Designed the database structure and its connection
Fixed critical security bugs and added features in a Java access-control system (Spring, JPA, Hibernate), making sign-in safer against unauthorized access

career.headline: Measured how AI finds answers (RAG)
career.story: Tested each part of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline to see what really helps an LLM answer accurately from a company’s own documents. It became my thesis.
points: Built a hybrid-search RAG pipeline (BM25 + dense retrieval + reranking) with Haystack and Weaviate, tested on 100 questions
Compared 3 PDF parsers, 4 embedding models, chunk sizes, top-k, search methods and prompt templates
Benchmarked 20 open-source LLMs (up to 14B parameters) on an NVIDIA A100 GPU, including how long each takes to answer
Qwen2.5-14B and OpenHermes-2.5-Mistral-7B beat GPT-4-Turbo on BERTScore

career.headline: Built an AI assistant for company documents
career.story: A chatbot that answers employees' questions using the company's own documents, built on what my thesis research found.
points: Rebuilt the whole RAG pipeline: tested PDF readers and adopted PyMuPDF
A PDF-to-embeddings ingestion pipeline that reduced hallucinations
Asked each question in several ways to widen the search: 30% better document matching
Designed the Weaviate database in the cloud and used OpenAI (GPT-4o) and DeepSeek models through LangChain, from retrieval to the final answer
Deployed the full-stack app on AWS in Docker containers, with Redis semantic caching and PostgreSQL

career.headline: Tutored classmates as an inclusion teacher
career.story: Helped undergraduate students with Discrete Mathematics, Algorithms and Data Structures, and Calculus I.
points: Explained concepts, solved exercises together and helped students get better results

career.headline: Designed a backend from scratch
career.story: A web app that compares companies on marketing metrics, such as key strengths and weaknesses. It uses LLMs on public data to give marketing teams insights for their communication strategy.
points: Chose the stack and designed a clean architecture
Middlewares, schema validation, API routes, error handling and database design
Firebase for sign-in, permissions and data; Instructor with Perplexity and OpenAI to gather data

career.headline: Semifinalist at Campus Mobile
career.story: MikoChain: an app that traces food along the whole supply chain, secured by blockchain.
points: National semifinalist in Campus Mobile, a competition run by Instituto Claro
Built the MVP with Node.js and React
Pitched at the on-site semifinal at USP, with teams from every region of Brazil

career.headline: Presented my research at IFES
career.story: Showed visitors how machine learning can find energy waste in campus data.
points: Presented the anomaly-detection project, including where to place the monitoring microcontrollers

career.headline: Backend for Capush, an iOS app
career.story: Capush: an iOS app, available on the App Store, that saves links from any platform into collections, with a nice preview of each one.
points: Designed and delivered the whole backend from scratch: sign-in, permissions and scalable file storage
A secure REST API in TypeScript with role-based access control (RBAC) and auditable permission changes
Middlewares, schema validation, API routes, error handling, and Firestore schemas designed for fast reads
Automatic deploys to Google Cloud Run: a CI/CD pipeline runs on every commit pushed to GitHub

career.headline: Graduated in Computer Science
career.story: Finished the degree, with the RAG benchmark as my final thesis: “Building a Sales Strategy Assistant Utilizing RAG and LLMs”.

career.headline: Software Engineer at LEVTY
career.story: Helping build the digital services a city hall uses to manage requests from its citizens.
points: Designing the architecture from scratch: role-based access control (RBAC) across departments, UI and web services, with design patterns
Designing BPMS processes, including a dispatcher that routes each citizen request to the right department
Building reusable React components for an Electronic Document Management (GED) system, covering each document's lifecycle
Leading requirements meetings with the client, including on site, and turning them into technical specifications
